super6.race: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
super6.comment: Enthusiastic front runner who saw off a well-backed handicap newcomer to land first hurdling success at Sedgefield in March. Shaped as though in need of the run when mid-field on reappearance under a conditional rider and England now back in the saddle.

super6.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
super6.comment: Foaled February 4. £16,000 yearling, Sioux Nation filly. Half-sister to useful 7f-8.5f winner Stayincotai and 2-y-o 7f-1¼m winner Captain Bruce. Dam unraced half-sister to useful winner up to 11f Menhoubah.

super6.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Won the 4m Hexham marathon over C&D in spring 2025. Successful at Bangor on his return last season and back to form when a close third here (3m) in May. Lots to like.

Low-mileage 5-y-o who was placed in points in spring 2025. Yet to really click but shaped as if better for the run with a hood refitted after 6 months off when sixth of 9 in handicap at Fontwell (2¼m, good to soft) just under 5 weeks ago. Big shout with that under his belt.

super6.race: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
super6.comment: Foaled April 7. 52,000 gns yearling, Minzaal colt. Half-brother to several winners, including useful 6f winner Isaan Queen and 6f/7f winner Conscript. Yard in good order but not known for winning newcomers. Stall 12 isn't ideal.

super6.race: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
super6.comment: Won a novice at Wetherby in April and shaped well in couple of handicaps after. Gelded during a 3-month summer break and returned with encouraging third of 9 in a classified stakes at Ascot in October last time, having to wait for a gap and looking unlucky. Can go very well back on all-weather.

finals.race: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Showed improved form third time out when second of 7 in 2m bumper at Taunton (good) in April, rallying well final 1f and just failing. Subsequently sold out of Tom Weston's yard for £22,000 and has each-way claims on hurdling debut.

finals.race: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: 5-y-o who confirmed debut promise following 9 months off when opening his account in 5-runner bumper at Uttoxeter (2m) in May. Possibly amiss when last of 6 at Newton Abbot (17f) in June but goes hurdling now with his stable in good form. Betting can guide.

finals.race: Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Won first 3 starts before an excellent third of 20 in the 2025 Albert Bartlett at the Cheltenham Festival. Looked far from a natural on chase bow at Ayr on sole start last season but shaped much better when third in Cheltenham novice last month after a year off. Non runner there Friday (bad scope).

finals.race: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
finals.comment: Enthusiastic front runner who saw off a well-backed handicap newcomer to land first hurdling success at Sedgefield in March. Shaped as though in need of the run when mid-field on reappearance under a conditional rider and England now back in the saddle.

finals.race: Golwg Gwendraeth Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Dual bumper scorer who took very well to hurdling, winning maiden/novice events prior to excellent fourth in the Supreme at Cheltenham Festival, impressing with how he went through the race. Too keen for his own good when third in Aintree Grade 1 final start and type to make a chaser.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
finals.comment: Foaled February 4. £16,000 yearling, Sioux Nation filly. Half-sister to useful 7f-8.5f winner Stayincotai and 2-y-o 7f-1¼m winner Captain Bruce. Dam unraced half-sister to useful winner up to 11f Menhoubah.

finals.race: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: In the process of running well when departing at the last over C&D on return 5 weeks ago, unlikely to have threatened the winner (has won again since) but seemingly booked for second. Needs considering off the same mark and type to respond well to first-time headgear (possibly not straightforward).

finals.race: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: One-time useful hurdler for Paul Nicholls but little form since 2023/24, showing only a glimmer of ability on second start for this yard at Uttoxeter on penultimate outing.

finals.race: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Third completed start in points. Yet to show much ability under Rules and headgear now applied on chase bow/return.

finals.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Made all in first-time headgear at Kelso (heavy) in February. Returned with a promising second to a next-time-out winner here (3m) 6 weeks ago. Shapes as if he'll stay extreme distances so bold show likely.

finals.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Won the 4m Hexham marathon over C&D in spring 2025. Successful at Bangor on his return last season and back to form when a close third here (3m) in May. Lots to like.

finals.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Shaped as if needing return back hurdling at Newcastle but proving expensive to follow over fences.

finals.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sharpened up by his recent return when resuming winning ways here (3m) 12 days ago, his deep reserves of stamina enabling him to pip the favourite. Worth a try at this marathon trip but third quick run in succession is a concern.

finals.race: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Winless since April 2024 but runner-up 3 times at Ayr last season. Reverted to jumping poorly after 8 months off there 18 days ago but worth a try at this extreme distance.

finals.race: Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £20,000 5-y-o, Idaho gelding. Brother to fair hurdler Tolka Row, and closely related to modest chaser Gustav. Won sole start in Irish points (Oct 3). One to consider on Rules bow.

finals.race: QuinnBet Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Long-standing maiden who hasn't made the track very often in recent seasons and didn't go with much promise after another absence at Ayr late last month.

finals.race: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Hadn't beaten a rival in 5 outings for current connections but staged a full-scale revival with cheekpieces fitted when winning 10-runner handicap at Worcester (2½m, soft) last month. Bowen retains the partnership and should give another good account from 4 lb higher.

finals.race: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Low-mileage 5-y-o who was placed in points in spring 2025. Yet to really click but shaped as if better for the run with a hood refitted after 6 months off when sixth of 9 in handicap at Fontwell (2¼m, good to soft) just under 5 weeks ago. Big shout with that under his belt.

finals.race: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: No promise in a bumper/over hurdles, latest after 5 months off. May well prove a different proposition now handicapping over a longer trip for a yard who certainly know the time of day.

finals.race: Welsh Cottage Christmas Cakes Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Lost his way for Shark Hanlon but having had a breathing operation/switched yards, shaped encouragingly in a first-time visor when second at Hexham (2½m, good to firm) in August (finished lame). Back over fences and fancied to feature under Sean Bowen (has had another breathing operation).

finals.race: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Foaled April 7. 52,000 gns yearling, Minzaal colt. Half-brother to several winners, including useful 6f winner Isaan Queen and 6f/7f winner Conscript. Yard in good order but not known for winning newcomers. Stall 12 isn't ideal.

finals.race: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Nursery
finals.comment: Improved when second of 8 in a handicap at Yarmouth in September, showing fairly useful form, but not in same form when last of 7 over C&D 21 days ago on all-weather debut, missing the break. Could show more if getting away on terms.

finals.race: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery
finals.comment: Went backwards from debut when fourth of 10 in novice at Bath (1m, soft) just under 3 weeks ago. Makes the quick switch to handicaps and in top hands, he very likely remains capable of better.

finals.race: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery
finals.comment: Standout effort when 5 lengths sixth of 10 in maiden at Sandown in late-August but should be better off now tackling a handicap for the first time.

finals.race: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
finals.comment: Created big impression when winning first 2 starts, both on all-weather, including over C&D on debut in January. Faced tough conditions when fourth of 9 over 7f in a handicap at Doncaster (evens favourite) on heavy going 26 days ago and holds strong claims back under these circumstances.

finals.race: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
finals.comment: Won a novice at Wetherby in April and shaped well in couple of handicaps after. Gelded during a 3-month summer break and returned with encouraging third of 9 in a classified stakes at Ascot in October last time, having to wait for a gap and looking unlucky. Can go very well back on all-weather.

finals.race: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
finals.comment: Very well-bred filly who built on debut promise to win a 7-runner novice over 11f at Southwell in October, still showing greenness but finding plenty for pressure. She's sure to be suited by greater tests of stamina and looks one to take very seriously on handicap debut.
